title: Church solos, pupils and the Bowles society band in Boston
summary: Waters met Howard Johnson, played piano solos in a Presbyterian church, gathered pupils, and played semi-classical solos with trumpeter Langston Curl in Bowles's society band. The reel ends mid-story.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: See, met other people. Boy, this is like - Howard Johnson was up there at the time , too -
